content.rendered:
The Gospel For Today | Saturday, May 16, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“Love never fails.”
1 Corinthians 13:8 (NIV) | ESV

Today’s Message

Three words. The simplest declaration in all of 1 Corinthians 13, the chapter the whole world knows as the love chapter. But these three words are the hinge on which everything else in the chapter turns.

Prophecies will cease. Tongues will be stilled. Knowledge will pass away. Everything that currently exists as a partial expression of something greater will one day give way to the complete reality. But love will not give way to anything because love is not a partial expression of something greater. Love is the thing itself. Love is what God is. And what God is does not fail.

Paul wrote this verse in the context of spiritual gifts, but the principle extends to every area of life. Every human relationship can fail. Every human institution can fail. Every plan, every strategy, every structure built by human hands can fail. Love never does. Not because love is a feeling that stays strong enough, but because the love being described here is not primarily a human emotion. It is the nature of God himself, expressed toward you through Jesus Christ.

We began this week with the declaration that nothing can separate you from the love of God. We close it here: that love never fails. Those two truths together form a wall around your life that is impenetrable. You cannot be separated from it and it cannot be defeated by anything it encounters. It simply does not fail.

Whatever in your life feels like it is failing today, whatever is wavering or uncertain or crumbling, bring it to this anchor: the love of God toward you in Christ Jesus does not fail. It has not failed. It will not fail. It never fails. Let that be your foundation as you close this week and begin the next.

Prayer

Father, Your love never fails. That is the ground on which I stand. Everything else may shift but Your love does not. I rest here today and I bring everything that feels uncertain in my life to the anchor of Your unfailing love. You have not failed me and You never will. In Jesus name. Amen.

Declaration

The love of God toward me in Christ Jesus never fails. It cannot be separated from me and it cannot be defeated by anything it encounters. I close this week anchored to that unchanging reality. His love never fails. That is enough. That is everything.
